scripts.format: npm run format:web && npm run format:dotnet
scripts.format:web: npm exec --workspace @quantara/web -- eslint app features shared --fix && prettier --write apps/web tools .vscode package.json
scripts.format:prepare: dotnet tool restore && dotnet restore Quantara.sln --verbosity quiet && dotnet build tools/Quantara.Analyzers/Quantara.Analyzers.csproj --no-restore --verbosity quiet && dotnet build tools/Quantara.CodeFixes/Quantara.CodeFixes.csproj --no-restore --verbosity quiet
scripts.format:dotnet: npm run format:prepare && dotnet csharpier format services tests tools && dotnet format Quantara.sln analyzers --diagnostics QNT005 --no-restore && dotnet format Quantara.sln style --diagnostics IDE2000 IDE2003 --no-restore && dotnet csharpier format services tests tools
scripts.format:check: npm run format:web:check && npm run format:dotnet:check
scripts.format:web:check: prettier --check apps/web tools .vscode package.json && npm run lint
scripts.format:dotnet:check: npm run format:prepare && dotnet csharpier check services tests tools && dotnet format Quantara.sln analyzers --diagnostics QNT005 --verify-no-changes --no-restore && dotnet format Quantara.sln style --diagnostics IDE2000 IDE2003 --verify-no-changes --no-restore
